name: pulse
subject: the RELAY "pulse" ship, a resonance spacecraft
identity: A round central core: a solid circular disc in dark navy #111834 with a bright neon pink #ff5c8a center. Around it, three thin concentric rings in neon pink with small gaps, evenly spaced, like a sound wave ringing outward. Four small separate floating devices (small diamond-shaped pods in navy with cyan #4ff0d8 edge lines) hover just outside the rings at the top, bottom, left and right, not touching the rings. A short pointed notch on the top of the core marks the nose. Hard-edged flat geometric silhouette, clean bold lines of one even weight, no realistic texture, no metal shading, no panel detail. Glow only on edges and the core.
